tasks.label: Start dev preview
tasks.prompt: Start the local development environment. Run `npm run dev` in the background — it launches the Shopify theme dev server (store: unrealistic-goals) together with the Tailwind CSS watcher via concurrently. Wait until the server is serving at http://127.0.0.1:9292, then open the Polyscope preview pointed at that URL. If the Shopify CLI needs authentication, surface the login URL so I can complete it.

tasks.label: Rebuild CSS & theme-check
tasks.prompt: Run `npm run build:css` to recompile assets/tailwind-output.css, then run `shopify theme check` and report any errors or warnings grouped by file.
